obligations.falsification_condition: Reject if an unstated preference or implementation detail is presented as a scientific or stakeholder requirement.
obligations.statement: A requirement is a source-custodied, purpose-bound and verifiable condition with conflicts, revisions and acceptance retained.
obligations.title: Engineering requirement

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject if a product label, component name or favorable output substitutes for the transformation.
obligations.statement: A function is a declared input-to-output transformation whose state, loss, context and failure modes remain explicit.
obligations.title: Required function

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject if a convenient target or hidden parameter is introduced as a necessary limit.
obligations.statement: A constraint is a source- and context-bound limit on generated designs, never an unexplained fitted preference.
obligations.title: Engineering constraint

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject if success inside one test envelope is universalized beyond its registered boundary.
obligations.statement: An operating boundary retains environment, loads, duration, transients, exceptions and observed failures.
obligations.title: Operating boundary

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject if intended use erases observed or foreseeable misuse.
obligations.statement: A use case retains actor, goal, preconditions, path and outcome; foreseeable misuse and harm remain co-registered.
obligations.title: Use and misuse case

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject if the criterion changes after outcome or authority alone declares compliance.
obligations.statement: Acceptance requires a preregistered criterion, method, result, uncertainty and preserved failure record.
obligations.title: Requirement acceptance boundary

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject if a name or vendor identity substitutes for measured behavior.
obligations.statement: A component is a versioned bounded part with declared state, capability, interfaces and failures.
obligations.title: Engineering component

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject if physical contact or a call name proves compatible exchange.
obligations.statement: An interface is a typed exchange contract retaining endpoints, units, timing, errors and version.
obligations.title: Engineering interface

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject if a diagram omits dependency, failure propagation or unrepresented components.
obligations.statement: Architecture is a versioned composition of components, interfaces and allocated responsibilities.
obligations.title: System architecture

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject if system-level success is inferred from isolated component success.
obligations.statement: An engineered system composes parts and relations around a declared purpose while retaining environment, users and failures.
obligations.title: Engineered system

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject if decomposition hides cross-module state or failure coupling.
obligations.statement: A modular decomposition is lawful only when interface contracts permit exact recomposition of required behavior.
obligations.title: Modular decomposition

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject if a final demonstration erases failed intermediate integrations.
obligations.statement: Integration retains component versions, assembly order, interface tests, failures and rollback state.
obligations.title: System integration

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject if an uncounted external supply or hidden computational service is omitted.
obligations.statement: Resource accounting retains stock, flow, units, time, loss and source for each operation.
obligations.title: Engineering resource

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject if peak, average or one successful load is universalized.
obligations.statement: Capacity is a load-profile-bound relation retaining duration, queuing, degradation and failure.
obligations.title: Capacity and load

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject efficiency above the closed resource account or omit externalized loss.
obligations.statement: Efficiency compares useful output with all registered input and loss inside an explicit boundary.
obligations.title: Engineering efficiency

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject if demonstrations omit failures, censored units or changed operating conditions.
obligations.statement: Reliability is a demand-, duration- and population-bound record of successful and failed service.
obligations.title: Reliability

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject if scheduled observation or missing monitoring becomes uptime.
obligations.statement: Availability retains serviceable and unavailable intervals, causes, maintenance and demand windows.
obligations.title: Availability

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject if absence of observed failure proves impossibility or all failures share one cause.
obligations.statement: A failure mode is an observed or generated loss-of-function path retaining cause, detectability, effect and recovery.
obligations.title: Failure mode

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject if display output alone proves the measurand or uncertainty is erased.
obligations.statement: Engineering measurement retains measurand, unit, instrument, conditions, uncertainty and record custody.
obligations.title: Engineering measurement

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject if adjustment, self-test or manufacturer status is called calibration without comparison.
obligations.statement: Calibration is a dated comparison to a traceable reference across a declared range and condition.
obligations.title: Calibration

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject if tolerance is widened after measurement or used as a fitted physical constant.
obligations.statement: A tolerance is a purpose- and uncertainty-bound allowed region registered before acceptance data.
obligations.title: Tolerance

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject if a demonstration without a criterion or preserved raw record is called a passed test.
obligations.statement: A test retains article version, setup, procedure, raw observations, deviations and unfavorable outcomes.
obligations.title: Engineering test

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject if target identity, threshold or scoring rule changes after the result opens.
obligations.statement: An acceptance test compares a frozen requirement and threshold to a source-custodied result.
obligations.title: Acceptance test

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject if uncertainty is omitted, tuned to force agreement or treated as proof error.
obligations.statement: Measurement uncertainty retains declared sources, correlations, method, coverage and revision.
obligations.title: Measurement uncertainty

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject if only the preferred design is generated or alternatives are invented after outcome.
obligations.statement: A design alternative must be generated from the frozen requirement grammar with every rejected option retained.
obligations.title: Design alternative

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject if an unexplained weight converts value judgment into an exact law.
obligations.statement: A trade-off retains distinct criteria, evidence, conflicts, stakeholders and losses without collapsing them into a hidden scalar.
obligations.title: Engineering trade-off

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject if an ungenerated design space, fitted weight or opaque oracle selects the optimum.
obligations.statement: Engineering optimization enumerates a declared finite design set and preserves ties, failures and constraint violations.
obligations.title: Bounded engineering optimization

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject if the decision is presented as a uniquely forced scientific truth.
obligations.statement: Multi-criteria choice keeps measured evidence separate from declared values, priorities and dissent.
obligations.title: Multi-criteria decision record

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject if favorable nominal operation proves robustness.
obligations.statement: A robust design retains performance across the preregistered condition family, including adverse corners.
obligations.title: Robust design

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject silent changes, retroactive baselines or unchanged receipts after source modification.
obligations.statement: A design freeze is a versioned baseline whose later changes require explicit impact, retest and provenance.
obligations.title: Design freeze and change control

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject if an unobserved state, hidden controller or unlimited action is assumed.
obligations.statement: Control maps an observed state to a bounded action with target, latency, limits and effects retained.
obligations.title: Control action

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject if correlation or repeated adjustment proves closed-loop feedback.
obligations.statement: A feedback loop retains plant, sensor, controller, actuator, delay, bounds, noise and failure paths.
obligations.title: Feedback loop

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject if one settled trace proves global or infinite-time stability.
obligations.statement: Stability is a finite operating-region claim retaining perturbation, return bound, overshoot and failures.
obligations.title: Operational stability

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject if an unheld predecessor is claimed recoverable from a merged output.
obligations.statement: Observability requires declared output histories to distinguish the registered internal state set.
obligations.title: Engineering observability

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject if an unreachable state is assumed or an unlimited actuator proves reachability.
obligations.statement: Controllability is reachability under declared actions, limits and duration with failed paths retained.
obligations.title: Engineering controllability

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject if no alarm proves no fault or response success erases missed detections.
obligations.statement: Fault response retains detection, misses, latency, bounded action, residual state and recovery.
obligations.title: Fault detection and response

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject if absence of prior harm proves safety or hazard is equated with realised harm.
obligations.statement: A hazard is a source-to-harm path retaining exposure, severity, likelihood and uncertainty.
obligations.title: Engineering hazard

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject if one scalar hides population distribution or ethical choice.
obligations.statement: Risk retains scenario evidence, exposure, consequence, uncertainty and declared value judgments separately.
obligations.title: Engineering risk record

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject if compliance, past success or authority alone proves safety.
obligations.statement: A safety case is a scoped claim supported by traceable evidence, controls, gaps and review.
obligations.title: Safety case

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject if an untested fault or silent continuation is called fail-safe.
obligations.statement: Fail-safe operation requires every declared fault to reach a tested bounded safe state or preserve a visible halt.
obligations.title: Fail-safe operation

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject if survival alone proves full recovery or hidden external aid is omitted.
obligations.statement: Resilience retains service loss, adaptation resources, recovery time, residual degradation and failed recovery.
obligations.title: Engineering resilience

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject if repeated copies with one common failure are called independent layers.
obligations.statement: Defence in depth requires separately testable barriers with dependencies, bypasses and common causes retained.
obligations.title: Defence in depth

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject if intended use, user approval or later performance substitutes for specification evidence.
obligations.statement: Verification tests whether a versioned artifact satisfies its frozen specification.
obligations.title: Engineering verification

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject if verification alone proves fitness for every user or deployment.
obligations.statement: Validation tests whether the verified system serves its declared use in its declared context.
obligations.title: Engineering validation

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject if an orphan requirement, untested design element or unowned result is admitted.
obligations.statement: Traceability connects need, requirement, design, implementation, test and result in both directions.
obligations.title: Bidirectional traceability

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject if a private environment, missing dependency or unreconstructible manual step is required.
obligations.statement: Reproducibility retains source, dependencies, environment, commands, outputs, failures and identities.
obligations.title: Engineering reproducibility

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject if the checker imports the first implementation’s survivor or output.
obligations.statement: An independent check reconstructs the result through a separately identified implementation path.
obligations.title: Implementation-distinct check

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject if mocks, placeholders, skipped stages or hidden manual corrections stand in for the pipeline.
obligations.statement: End-to-end verification exercises the declared public entry through every stage to its final receipt.
obligations.title: End-to-end verification

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject if success on one operating system proves portability.
obligations.statement: Cross-platform evidence preserves macOS, Windows and Linux environments, results and platform-specific differences.
obligations.title: Cross-platform behavior

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject if one proprietary application or unstated locale is required to interpret it.
obligations.statement: A portable record has an open schema, explicit encoding, version, units, errors and migration path.
obligations.title: Portable data and record format

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject if developer usability or visual presentation alone proves accessibility.
obligations.statement: An accessible interface retains user diversity, input and output modes, errors, guidance and direct testing.
obligations.title: Accessible human interface

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject if Docker, a cloud service, administrator access or a hidden heavyweight dependency is silently required.
obligations.statement: Lightweight deployment declares and minimizes runtime dependencies, permissions, downloads and infrastructure.
obligations.title: Lightweight deployment

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject if the command skips claims, mutates authority or needs undisclosed setup.
obligations.statement: A single documented command reaches the complete verification route and reports progress, duration, failures and receipt.
obligations.title: One-command public verification

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject if expert familiarity is treated as evidence that any person can use the system.
obligations.statement: Learnable operation retains audience, prerequisites, progressive guidance, errors, examples and user tests.
obligations.title: Learnable public operation

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject if mutable latest versions or hidden settings preserve the same identity.
obligations.statement: Configuration identity binds source, dependencies, settings, platform and hashes to a dated behavior.
obligations.title: Configuration identity

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject if maintenance history or induced failures are erased.
obligations.statement: Maintenance retains diagnosis, parts, action, test, downtime and resulting configuration.
obligations.title: Maintenance action

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject if a changed dependency is declared irrelevant without trace evidence.
obligations.statement: Change impact traces a proposed modification through affected requirements, interfaces, hazards, tests and releases.
obligations.title: Change impact

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject if disabling a service proves data, hazard or dependency removal.
obligations.statement: Decommissioning retains authority, users, data, materials, hazards, recovery and archive custody.
obligations.title: Decommissioning

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject if manufacturing, operation, maintenance or end-of-life is omitted from a whole-life claim.
obligations.statement: A lifecycle record connects need, design, build, use, maintenance and retirement with resources and impacts retained.
obligations.title: Full lifecycle record

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject if one favorable indicator, offset or displaced harm proves sustainability.
obligations.statement: A sustainability claim retains lifecycle boundary, resources, emissions, labour, distribution, uncertainty and trade-offs.
obligations.title: Bounded sustainability claim

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject if an application target selects or rewrites the upstream law.
obligations.statement: Engineering translation consumes an admitted law and records every added design choice, assumption, boundary and test.
obligations.title: Scientific-law translation

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject if successful performance is presented as retroactive proof of the law.
obligations.statement: Performance is a version- and condition-bound implementation result, not a fundamental scientific law.
obligations.title: Design performance

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject if engineering failure is automatically relabelled scientific falsification.
obligations.statement: A failed implementation can falsify its operating claim while leaving the upstream law unchanged unless a valid anomaly bridge is established.
obligations.title: Implementation failure boundary

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject if a prototype demonstration is called production validation or universal proof.
obligations.statement: Prototype evidence retains omissions, fidelity, setup, failures and the bounded question it answers.
obligations.title: Prototype evidence

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject if simulated output is relabelled measured performance.
obligations.statement: A simulation retains its model, discretization, inputs, assumptions, error and comparison; it is not an observation.
obligations.title: Engineering simulation boundary

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject if a compelling display replaces complete testing or external evidence.
obligations.statement: A demonstration shows bounded behavior in a retained scenario and remains distinct from verification, validation and science admission.
obligations.title: Engineering demonstration

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject if surprise, noise, undocumented configuration or post-hoc expectation is called an anomaly.
obligations.statement: An anomaly is a source-custodied deviation from a preregistered engineering expectation with controls and repeats retained.
obligations.title: Engineering anomaly

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject if the implementation directly edits a scientific law or bypasses branch admission.
obligations.statement: A validated anomaly returns as a question to its categorical science owner; it does not enter the model through Engineering.
obligations.title: Return of anomaly to science

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject if platform behavior rewrites computation law or formal correctness proves usable deployment.
obligations.statement: Computation owns formal semantics; Engineering owns the versioned executable translation and deployment evidence.
obligations.title: Software and computation handoff

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject if material or environmental behavior is inferred from product success without scientific admission.
obligations.statement: Physics, Chemistry, Materials, Earth and Astronomy own their laws; Engineering owns bounded artifacts using them.
obligations.title: Physical sciences handoff

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject if device performance proves diagnosis, subjective experience, equal access or ethical legitimacy.
obligations.statement: Biology, Medicine, Consciousness and Social Science retain their evidence while Engineering translates a bounded intervention.
obligations.title: Biological, medical and social handoff

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject if a self-hosted implementation becomes authority merely by reproducing itself or changes the protected V3 record.
obligations.statement: A future V4 self-hosted rebuild must reproduce V3 semantics, receipts and constraints through an independently auditable bootstrap.
obligations.title: SFT-derived self-hosted V4 handoff

consumed_not_reowned: individual biological clinical conscious or social states
ownership_boundary.owned: Versioned translation of admitted laws into bounded designs, instruments, processes, software, tests, deployments and demonstrations.

scope: Requirements, function, boundaries, components, interfaces, systems, resources, measurement, design alternatives, control, safety, verification, cross-platform access, lifecycle, science-design distinction and anomaly handoff.
